text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let's confirm today's 
schedule. After school, attend an 
acquaintance's birthday party. After that, 
reply to the congratulatory messages 
received—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Ikuno-san. You really don't have 
to micromanage my personal life to such a 
detail...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"You could say... this is simply my own 
little way of wishing you a happy 
birthday."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Turning down such kindness would bring 
shame upon the Mejiro name. I must steel 
my resolve and enjoy today to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just one thing, however. In order to truly 
have a fulfilling birthday, there's 
another plan we must add to the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Adding to the schedule? I will adjust it 
immediately. What will this entail?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Could you spare about an hour after this 
afternoon's dinner party?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I happened upon some fine tea leaves. If 
we are to make this the perfect day, 
Ikuno-san must enjoy herself as well.
